judgement.doubts: Both events are cases of a conjecture stated for all k and l, so `partial`. They settle different cases and neither supersedes the other, so under step 4 the AI role is the stronger of the two, `generated`, from Bonnet. The earlier human correction (claimed → partial) was right. Its scope is the bullet's whole conjecture, not just the first open case. Bonnet's result has only a sorry-free Lean build and no named expert reading (F10), so it counts as unreviewed. That doesn't change the tier for a case. I did no searches: the codes don't depend on whether it has been digested since.
